image_description: A close-up view of a vintage-style wall-mounted barometer. The instrument features a dark, polished wooden casing with an elongated, decorative upper section and a circular lower section housing the dial. The dial has a white face with black markings and a gold-colored bezel. A small brass fitting connects the two sections. The background consists of light-colored horizontal siding or paneling.
